annotations.title: Check available cars and full prices

description: Lists the rental cars that are free in North Cyprus (Kıbrıs araç kiralama) for a pickup and return time, each with its photo, its full price and a link that opens the booking form on that car. With a pickup place, return place or add-ons, total_eur includes them.

addons.description: Optional extras charged per day. casco is full cover; young_driver applies to drivers aged 21 to 24.

category.description: Optional car class. Omit for every class.

currency.description: Also price in this currency (total_quoted). EUR is always included.

language.description: Language of the result and the booking link: 'tr' for Turkish, otherwise 'en'.

pickup_at.description: Pickup date-time 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm', Cyprus local time, within the booking hours.

pickup_location.description: Where the car is handed over. Omit for the Kipra office. The airports and Bafra cost extra.

return_at.description: Return date-time 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm', after pickup_at, within the booking hours.

return_location.description: Where the car comes back. Omit for the office.

name: check_car_availability

booking_url.description: Opens the list of cars for these dates.
Opens the booking form on this car.

rental_eur.description: The car alone: daily rate × days.

total_eur.description: What the person pays, with add-ons and place fees.

title: Check available cars and full prices
